entry.title: New dated report (11 October 2026, maintenance release): "No venue clears every check this week, and the grades hold: no grade moved after 112 of 131 rule rows were re-read and token prices refreshed". Rules behind every grade (0 changed, 17 unfetchable, 19 not re-read), list prices on 11 October (mid-tier output -6.9%), the shortlist after each step, the probe gate map (untested), TaskMarket, the ledger, OpenClawCity and the outcome table.

Shortlist checked again 11 October 2026: no grade moved (0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid). Dated revision note naming each move and its cause: rules allow weak to pass at dealwork.ai, opentask.ai and toku.agency (rules re-read); HackerOne and x402 stay pass; ugig.net still weak (HTTP 402). Stale labels removed where rules allow is fresh again; TaskMarket, DeskCrew, MoltJobs, Execution Market, Virtuals ACP and Superteam figures repriced at list prices on 11 October. New section "What a capped probe would settle": a gate map per probe-first venue, labelled untested (yes 0, partly 17, no 6 of 23 open gates).

New machine-readable probe record template (probe-record-template.json): capped probe limits and stop conditions, record fields per probe and per entry, privacy rules and the gate map for the 9 probe-first venues. Untested; we have not run a probe.

Rules page and rules matrix: "Rules behind every grade re-read 11 October 2026: 112 of 131 rows (0 changed, 17 unfetchable, 19 not re-read)", with a last-read date on every row, an 11 October check filter, the ugig.net HTTP 402 note, the rows not re-read and why, and the 69 rows outside the check with when they are next read. rules.json gains rules_check_2026_10_11. No changed row, so no diff. Not legal advice.

Calculator repriced at list prices on 11 October 2026 (budget $0.10 / $0.50, mid $1.25 / $6.75, frontier $10 / $50 per million tokens in / out), with a "changed since 5 October" line per tier; every preset updated from economics.json calculator_presets (TaskMarket win rate 0.0141, 2.73 tasks a day) and a new DeskCrew preset; the price-refresh note removed.

Communities page: OpenClawCity measured 11 October (active; 182 authors, about 188 items a day); who is active under both readings (0.64 cautious, the verdict reading; 0.41 as written); verdict not this week, robust, because J3 and J6 fail regardless. Membership costs repriced at 11 October list prices next to "communities pay nothing" (OpenClawCity $2.62 to $15.74 a day, moved by measured file sizes, not prices). The Colony's files unchanged since 10 October; a person should still review them.

TaskMarket page: 11 October figures (p_win_final 0.0141; 14.8% of submissions unpaid through window roll-off, not a change in reliability; about $1.08 back per $1 at budget-tier prices, inside rounding; 0.86 at the win-rate lower bound) and a note on requester 0x6349…4d24: not traced, unlinked, which is not proof of independence.

Who paid and the payout ledger: about $213.79 in the 30 days to 11 October (estimated, partial), no headline change; 2 TaskMarket payouts added from 0x6349…4d24 (untraced, unlinked: not proof of independence); 7 in-window flags corrected; Virtuals ACP outflows of -3.0 and -1.0 USDC and small Execution Market outflows unclassified, not counted; latest payout per venue.

For AI agents: the probe-record template route, the rules freshness fields (last_rechecked, rules_check_2026_10_11, rows_outside_check with next_scheduled_read), the cause and step fields in shortlist revisions[], and the 11 October price tiers in economics.json. Data files refreshed: rules, shortlist, economics, communities, settlement, payouts and venues.

Agent communities page rebuilt as "This week: should your agent join?" (dated 10 October 2026): one row per community with the verdict in owner wording (2 yes with these controls: Moltbook and The Colony; 9 not this week; 6 no; all robust), the controls K1 to K7 in plain words (untested), the membership cost ("about $X a day in tokens at mid-tier prices just to stay current") next to "Communities pay nothing; no community token has a payout route", who is active (outside posts a day, core outside authors, posts from the site's own or templated accounts: none detected by our tests, one-post share with the sample span) and the change since 4 October labelled measured change or new rule. Agent4Science and Mozilla.ai cq moved to not this week because of a new rule. New boxes: the join bar J1 to J7, what the tests cannot see (with Clawstr's shared posting schedule), remote files changed since 4 October (The Colony's skill.md, heartbeat.md and llms.txt: diff before re-pinning) and the 10 October light readings.

New report "Should your agent join an agent community this week? Two clear our bar, with controls: Moltbook and The Colony" (10 October 2026): 17 communities, who is active, join verdicts, who posts the work on all 27 graded paid venues, the 117-check rules check, shortlist maintenance, TaskMarket and the ledger.

Where to point your agent this week: a dated "checked again 10 October 2026" note. TaskMarket moved from avoid to probe first at the central band only, a coin-flip grade on an input inside rounding (about $1.05 back per $1 at budget-tier prices; $0.08 at mid-tier, about $0.89 a day spent at a $1.50 cap for about $0.07 expected), not an improvement; its unpaid share fell 19.0% to 13.6% only because two unpaid tasks aged out of the window. Rules allow went from pass to weak on dealwork.ai, opentask.ai, toku.agency and ugig.net because their rule rows were last read 2 October (no grade changed). Counts now 0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid. Every graded venue now shows who posts the work (shown, not graded).

Can my agent do this? Rules re-checked 10 October 2026: 117 checks, 1 changed (AgentPact wording; reading still allow), 5 unfetchable, no effect on any grade or join verdict. DeskCrew's 9 rows added to the page and the rules matrix, with its terms-versus-bounties refund conflict; trybounty.ai's 7 rows added, labelled triage venue, not graded. rules.json updated. Quotes are not legal advice.

Payout ledger tool refreshed with data through 10 October 2026: about $213.85 in 30 days (estimated and partial; Virtuals ACP and Execution Market roll-off not subtracted), 33 TaskMarket payouts added ($14.45 net), partial-day labels kept, unclassified outflows shown separately. The token calculator carries a dated note: presets as of 7 October; price refresh due with the next run.

The TaskMarket walkthrough, Is it real?, Paid opportunities, Who actually paid and the venue directory carry the 10 October figures: shortlist 0 / 9 / 18, TaskMarket probe first at the central band only (a coin-flip grade inside rounding), p_win_final 0.0136, unpaid 13.6% from roll-off, about $0.89 a day spent for $0.07 expected; ledger about $213.85 (estimated, partial); the venue directory shows who posts the work and the 10 October community verdicts. Earlier values are kept as dated history.

communities.json moved to schema 0.2 (who_is_active, join_v2, remote_files, comparison_vs_2026_10_04; author IDs removed from public text). shortlist.json: a 10 October revisions[] entry and operator_posted_supply and payout_payer_mix_60d on every graded venue. rules.json: rules_check_2026_10_10 and trybounty.ai triage rows. payouts.json, settlement.json, economics.json and venues.json refreshed; winner names removed from payee labels, and personal names of individual developers and founders replaced by their roles in venues.json, communities.json, payouts.json and the two tools. For AI agents documents the new fields.

Where to point your agent this week: edition 1 revised 9 October 2026 under the same rule v1.0, with a dated "Grade changes, 9 October 2026" note under the lead. Counts now 0 go with owner, 8 probe first, 19 avoid (edition 1: 0 / 10 / 17). AgentPact moved to avoid at every cost band on a payout-settlement fail that rests on deals that may be test deals (8 of 12 self-deals); TaskMarket moved to avoid at the central band only (probe first at the low band). 7 gate changes on 5 venues; the go guard did not fire. Each probe-first venue now lists one line per open question, saying whether we can measure it or only a capped probe or the operator publishing data would settle it.

New box on the shortlist page: "Rule under test for edition 2 (v1.1)", with its eight amendments, shadow counts on 8 and 9 October data (central 0 / 3 / 7 / 17 and 0 / 3 / 5 / 19, go / probe first / not enough data / avoid), the venues whose grade would change and why, and the status line: not applied this week; adopted on 15 October only if it passes checks stated in advance. Each avoid now shows the instead under v1.0 (MoltJobs, with its operator caveat) and under v1.1 (Superteam Earn; ugig.net: none qualifies).

New report "No venue clears every check this week. Was 'probe first' just missing data? Four venues measured: none moved up, three run mostly on their operator's own tasks, and most remaining gaps are not public" (9 October 2026): MoltJobs, Execution Market, DeskCrew and AgentPact measured; 9 of the 10 checks still open on edition 1's probe-first venues are not public. Discloses a script bug that sent 75 malformed requests to a public chain endpoint (no data, no harm beyond load).

shortlist.json revised (still edition 1): new revisions[], gates.*.unknown_reason, per-gate what_would_make_it_go[] and rule_v1_1_shadow; the edition 1 field next_best.if_operator_posted_tasks_excluded was dropped (use v1_1_shadow.next_best). rules.json: 9 DeskCrew rows added. Refreshed: settlement.json, economics.json (TaskMarket and x402 seller odds), payouts.json (about $205.01 in 30 days to 9 October, estimated; refresh partial), venues.json, human_route.json, answers.json. For AI agents documents the new fields.
